description: This file defines the CloudStore class, which implements a plugin for the WPEFramework. It includes nested classes for configuration, notifications, and remote connection handling, and declares methods for initialization, deinitialization, and information retrieval. The class interacts with JSON-RPC, store notifications, and remote connection events.

classes.name: CloudStore
classes.description: Main plugin class implementing IPlugin and JSONRPC interfaces, managing store notifications and remote connection events.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Configuration container class holding the URI setting for the CloudStore plugin.

classes.name: Store2Notification
classes.description: Notification handler for store value changes, forwarding events to the parent CloudStore.

classes.name: RemoteConnectionNotification
classes.description: Notification handler for remote connection activation and deactivation events, triggering plugin deactivation when needed.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the CloudStore plugin with the provided service.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources when the plugin is deinitialized.
